faq.title: A few things to know.
faq.download.question: Can I download a ready-made app?
faq.download.answer: Not yet. The project currently provides source code and local builds, not a notarized binary release. The commands above build an ad-hoc signed app for your Mac.
faq.scaling.question: Will it fix display scaling?
faq.scaling.answer: It selects mirror or extend mode and the mirror source. macOS and your hardware still determine supported resolutions. Different aspect ratios can produce scaling or black bars.
faq.privacy.question: What about privacy and compatibility?
faq.privacy.answer: No analytics, screen capture, or application network requests are implemented. Full multi-display hardware and UI testing is still in progress. Review the testing checklist before relying on it in a presentation.
